# wayfinder_application (Resource)

Application represents an application you are planning to use Wayfinder to serve environments for.

<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud defines which cloud provider this application is being developed for.
- `name` (String) Name is the human-readable name for this application.

Optional:

- `components` (Block List) Components are the definition of the components that make up this application. These are optional, but if specified, Wayfinder can generate example manifests for your application with the components wired together. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--components))
- `description` (String) Description is an optional longer human-readable description of this application to help users understand a bit about it.
- `key` (String) Key is a system-wide unique DNS-compatible name for this application. If unspecified on creation a suitable value will be derived from the name. If specified, it will be validated for uniqueness on entry.

<a id="nestedblock--spec--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.components`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name is the unique name for this component within the application.
- `type` (String) Type is the component type

Optional:

- `cloud_resource` (Block List, Max: 1) CloudResource defines the settings for a cloud resource component, required if Type is CloudResource (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--components--cloud_resource))
- `container` (Block List, Max: 1) Container defines the settings for a container component, required if Type is Container (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--components--container))
- `depends_on` (List of String) DependsOn is a list of other components that this component depends on - e.g. if this is a container component and needs access to the outputs of a cloud resource, place the name of the cloud resource component here.
- `key` (String) Key is a unique (within the app) DNS-compatible name for this component. If unspecified on creation a suitable value will be derived from the name. If specified, it will be validated for uniqueness on entry.

<a id="nestedblock--spec--components--cloud_resource"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.components.cloud_resource`

Required:

- `plan` (String) Plan identifies the cloud resource plan to use for this cloud resource

Optional:

- `variables` (Map of String) Variables is a set of variables to provide to the associated Terraform module when applying. This will be validated against the policy on the specified plan, and override any values provided in that plan.


<a id="nestedblock--spec--components--container"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.components.container`

Required:

- `image` (String) Image is the fully-specified container image to use for this component

Optional:

- `env` (Block List) Env is a set of environment variables to expose in this container (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--components--container--env))
- `expose` (Boolean) Expose makes this component available outside the cluster by creating an ingress for it
- `port` (Number) Port is the primary port this component exposes to other components or for external traffic
- `tls` (Boolean) TLS ensures that the component is exposed with an HTTPS TLS certificate (only relevant if expose is true)
- `whitelist` (List of String) Whitelist, if set, will restrict access to the specified IP ranges, specified in CIDR notation (only relevant if expose is true)

<a id="nestedblock--spec--components--container--env"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.components.container.env`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name is the name of the environment variable to set in the container

Optional:

- `from_cloud_resource_output` (Block List, Max: 1) FromCloudResourceOutput gets the value from a dependent cloud resource component's outputs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--components--container--env--from_cloud_resource_output))
- `value` (String) Value is a hard-coded value that this environment variable should always have
